input_data.description: The data to split — an array, or an object that contains the array field(s). e.g. {{node-id.items}}
input_data.title: Input Data

fields_to_split.description: The field(s) holding the array to split out. Comma-separate to split multiple; dot notation supported. Leave empty if the input is itself an array.
fields_to_split.title: Fields To Split Out

include.description: Which of the input's other fields to keep on each output item.
include.title: Include

fields_to_include.description: Comma-separated field names to keep on each item.
fields_to_include.title: Fields To Include

destination_field.description: Rename the split field on each output item (single field only).
destination_field.title: Destination Field Name

description: Full configuration for the Split Out node (no credentials).

credentials.description: Credentials for this node (optional if using environment variables)
credentials.title: Credentials

title: Split-out Node Configuration
